calculation.expression: if s_t>0 then -(ret_5d)*(1+s_t) else -(ret_5d)*0.5, where s_t=clip(VIX_ret_5d,-0.5,0.5)
calculation.description: Ranks assets for short-horizon reversal, increasing reversal exposure when the observation-only VIX has risen over the prior five completed sessions and attenuating it otherwise. Asset returns and VIX shock are lagged through the prior completed bar; VIX is macro observation only and is never traded directly.

validation.regime_notes: Daily result remains positive in 2020-2026; strongest in 2022 and 2024, weaker but positive in 2025-2026. Conservative interpretation is required because the cross-section is only 15 instruments and VIX-conditioned coverage is approximately half of asset-date observations.
